tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background — the canvas every section sits on.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the nav bar, inputs: anything that sits one step above `bg`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hover state of cards, menus, code blocks, the second step above `bg`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, dividers, the grid pattern. Decorative only — never the only thing that marks a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons). Holds 3:1 on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings, on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-raised` and `primary-soft`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, metadata, captions, placeholders. Readable (≥4.5:1) on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-raised` and `primary-soft`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: THE brand violet. Primary button fill, active nav indicator, focus ring, cover blocks, the cursor. Same value in both themes. Not for body-size text on light grounds — use `primary-ink`.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill of a `primary` surface. `on-primary` text stays legible on it.

tokens.name: primary-ink
tokens.usage: Violet as TEXT: links, the eyebrow label, highlighted words, active tab label. ≥4.5:1 on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-raised` and `primary-soft`.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind `primary-ink` text: selected tags, the active nav pill, text selection.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `primary` or `primary-hover` fill (the primary button label). Deliberately dark in both themes: white on #A25BFF is only 3.8:1.

tokens.name: logo-word
tokens.usage: The word "Ram" in the logo and the nav brand — a pale violet in Dark, a deep violet in Light, in harmony with the `primary` R. On `bg`, `surface`, `surface-raised` (≥8:1 both themes). Logo only.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: a solid 2px ring, 2px offset. Alias of `primary`; ≥3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status as text or icon ("Available for work", form sent). Teal, off the red–green axis; always paired with a word. On the surfaces or `success-soft`.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind `success` text in status badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution as text or icon ("Limited availability"). On the surfaces or `warning-soft`.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind `warning` text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors as text, icon or input border (form validation). Always with a message, never color alone. On the surfaces or `danger-soft`.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind `danger` text: the error banner.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links in prose — alias of `primary-ink`, underlined on hover.

groups.name: Display & headings
groups.note: Readex Pro (Lexend's Arabic-Latin sibling, built for reading ease). Headings 600, tight tracking in Latin only.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: I build fast, clear web apps.
styles.usage: Hero headline only, once per page. Drops to `h1` size under 768px.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Full-stack JavaScript developer in Cairo, building with Next.js, React and Node.
styles.usage: Hero intro and lead paragraphs. Light (300) weight reads well at this size in the dark theme.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I'm driven by a passion for creating inspiring digital experiences.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata, helper text under inputs, footer.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, nav links, form labels, tags.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: JetBrains Mono for the technical layer. Arabic falls back to Readex Pro Arabic, untracked.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section kicker above an `h2`, uppercase, in `primary-ink`. In Arabic: no uppercase, no tracking.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code, terminal snippets, stat units, version numbers.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Big figures in stat cards. Western digits (0–9) in both languages.

groups.name: Arabic
groups.note: Same family; looser leading because Arabic needs room for marks above and below. Never letter-space Arabic.

styles.name: body-ar
styles.sample: مطوّر JavaScript متكامل من القاهرة، أعمل بـ Next.js وReact وNode.js.
styles.usage: Arabic paragraph text — one pixel larger than `body` to match Latin x-height.

spacing.note: 4px base. Sections breathe; components stay compact.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between tags, icon-to-label in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input and button vertical padding pairs, small card stacks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on mobile; button horizontal padding; stack gap in cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; grid gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; eyebrow-to-content gap.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between a section title and its content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Grid pattern pitch; section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Vertical padding between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero top padding on desktop.

radius.note: Precise, not pill-soft. Small radii everywhere; full only for status dots and the avatar.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inline code, focus-ring corners on text links.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, badges, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav pill.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, project thumbnails, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dot, avatar.

shadow.note: Dark theme leans on borders and a violet glow, not drop shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and small raised controls.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, the sticky nav once scrolled.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Hovered project card and the primary CTA on hover. At most one glowing element on screen.

duration.note: Motion is quick and functional; honour prefers-reduced-motion by dropping to 0ms.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Color and border changes on hover.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Card lift, glow in, menu open.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Section reveal on scroll, 3D cube face transitions.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything entering or responding to the pointer.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Cube rotation and full-screen face expand/collapse.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width; centered with `space-4` (mobile) / `space-6` (desktop) gutters.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of a paragraph block.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Sticky nav bar height; also the scroll-margin-top of section anchors.
